headline: Adoption of a 2026-2029 contract with the Portland Administrators Association, and a preview of the Fiscal 2028 Capital Improvement Plan.
summary: A middle schools workshop and briefs on family engagement and enrollment trends are on the agenda. Teacher candidate hires and an executive session on contract talks with the Portland Administrators Association are also listed.
